title: ClearTalk: Data-Driven Mandarin Articulation Analysis and Personalized Communication Support for Children with Dysarthria
abstract: arXiv:2611.21639v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Children with dysarthria may experience reduced intelligibility and difficulty expressing everyday needs. ClearTalk is a smartwatch-based system that converts Mandarin speech-recognition differences into interpretable articulatory profiles for personalized practice and staged communication. Target and recognized utterances are aligned at the syllable level, summarized across seven articulatory positions, and ranked by a count-sensitive asymmetric heuristic. For 13 dysarthric speakers from the Mandarin Dysarthria Speech Corpus, system syllable-level accuracy showed a Pearson correlation of 0.908 with expert intelligibility, with an R-squared value of 0.824 and a p-value below 0.001. translated_title: ClearTalk：面向构音障碍儿童的普通话构音数据分析与个性化沟通支持
translated_abstract: 患有构音障碍的儿童可能面临言语清晰度下降以及表达日常需求困难的问题。ClearTalk 是一个基于智能手表的系统，它将普通话语音识别的差异转化为可解释的构音特征画像，用于支持个性化练习和分阶段沟通。系统将目标话语与识别话语在音节层面进行对齐，汇总到七个构音部位上，并通过计数敏感的非对称启发式方法进行排序。对于来自普通话构音障碍语音语料库的 13 名构音障碍说话者，系统的音节级准确率与专家清晰度评分的皮尔逊相关系数达到 0.908，R² 值为 0.824，p 值小于 0.001。系统选择的重点训练目标与三名盲评言语语言病理学家的共识达到 86.7% 的重合度；在 210 个目标辅音上，自动标注达到 86.7% 的一致率，Cohen's kappa 为 0.76，宏平均 F1……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: ClearTalk 是一款基于智能手表的系统，它将普通话语音识别差异转化为可解释的音节级构音部位画像，为构音障碍儿童提供个性化练习与分阶段沟通支持，其准确率与专家清晰度评分高度相关（r=0.908），且自动选择的目标与言语病理学家共识高度一致。
en_tdlr: ClearTalk is a smartwatch-based system that converts Mandarin speech-recognition differences into interpretable syllable-level articulatory profiles, enabling personalized practice and staged communication for children with dysarthria, achieving 0.908 correlation with expert intelligibility ratings and strong agreement with speech-language pathologists' consensus.
